sections.description:
Connect your Stockpress workspace to WordPress and quickly find and add files from your Stockpress workspace to your website.

What is Stockpress?

Stockpress is a refreshingly simple Digital Asset Management system–for everyone. One centralized workspace to add, organize, collaborate on, and share files with unlimited users and teams.

How to get started:

  • First, sign up for a Stockpress workspace (get started for free!)
  • Upload or import your files and folders to get organized
  • Install the Stockpress plugin for WordPress and connect your account
  • Easily add files from Stockpress to your WordPress website

For help, contact us through your in-workspace chat or email us at help@stockpress.co.

External services

This plugin connects to Stockpress to allow you to browse and search your files and add them to your website. After connecting your Stockpress workspace to your WordPress website, your personal authentication token (NOT your password) is stored in the WordPress database and sent to Stockpress servers every time you open the Stockpress browser in the Media Library modal. The plugin DOES NOT send any personal information to Stockpress servers or to any other third-party services. The only information sent to Stockpress are: plugin version, your authentication token (obtained from Stockpress during the connection process) and your website URL. For more details on how we use your data check our Terms of Use and Privacy Policy.
